import { rwDel, rwGet, rwPost, rwPut } from "/src/features/research-workspace/api/client.ts";
function treeFromItems(items) {
  const root = { name: "", path: "", type: "dir", kind: "dir", children: [] };
  for (const it of items) {
    const parts = String(it.path || "").split("/").filter(Boolean);
    let cur = root;
    parts.forEach((seg, i) => {
      const isLeaf = i === parts.length - 1;
      const acc = parts.slice(0, i + 1).join("/");
      cur.children = cur.children ?? [];
      let next = cur.children.find((c) => c.name === seg);
      if (!next) {
        next = isLeaf ? { name: seg, path: acc, type: "file", kind: it.kind, revision: it.revision, size: it.size, children: [] } : { name: seg, path: acc, type: "dir", kind: "dir", children: [] };
        cur.children.push(next);
      }
      cur = next;
    });
  }
  const sortNodes = (nodes) => {
    nodes.sort((a, b) => (a.type !== "dir" ? 1 : 0) - (b.type !== "dir" ? 1 : 0) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    for (const n of nodes) if (n.children) n.children = sortNodes(n.children);
    return nodes;
  };
  return sortNodes(root.children ?? []);
}
export async function getTree(projectId) {
  const r = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/files`);
  if (Array.isArray(r?.tree) && r.tree.length) return r.tree;
  return treeFromItems(r?.items ?? []);
}
export async function getFile(projectId, path) {
  const r = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/files/${encodePath(path)}`);
  const f = r?.file;
  return {
    path: f?.path ?? path,
    content: f?.content ?? "",
    revision: Number(f?.revision ?? 0),
    saved_at: f?.saved_at ?? f?.updated_at ?? ""
  };
}
export async function putFile(projectId, path, content, expectedRevision) {
  const r = await rwPut(`/projects/${projectId}/files/${encodePath(path)}`, {
    content,
    expected_revision: expectedRevision
  });
  const f = r?.file;
  return {
    path: f?.path ?? path,
    content,
    revision: Number(f?.revision ?? expectedRevision + 1),
    saved_at: f?.saved_at ?? f?.updated_at ?? ""
  };
}
export async function createFile(projectId, path, kind = "tex", content = "") {
  const r = await rwPost(`/projects/${projectId}/files`, { path, kind, content });
  const f = r?.file;
  return {
    path: f?.path ?? path,
    content,
    revision: Number(f?.revision ?? 1),
    saved_at: f?.saved_at ?? f?.updated_at ?? ""
  };
}
export async function deleteFile(projectId, path) {
  await rwDel(`/projects/${projectId}/files/${encodePath(path)}`);
}
export async function renameFile(projectId, from, to) {
  await rwPost(`/projects/${projectId}/files:rename`, { from, to });
}
export async function getOutline(projectId, entry = "main.tex") {
  const r = await rwGet(
    `/projects/${projectId}/outline`,
    { entry }
  );
  const src = r?.source_file ?? entry;
  return (r?.items ?? []).map((it) => ({ ...it, file: it.file || src }));
}
function encodePath(path) {
  return path.split("/").map((seg) => encodeURIComponent(seg)).join("/");
}
